rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Amun, sun and air god in ram-headed form.
ANATOMY: one ram head on male body, two curved horns, two arms; full opaque Egyptian robe, no weapon [amun-c03]
MOMENT: Three-quarter turn into wind, hand grasps plain column, other gathers cloak, face looking down
POWER: wind physically sweeps robes and desert dust, documented wind aspect [amun-c01, amun-c16, amun-c20]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low camera; tight framing and strong foreshortening; subject fills most of square, no invented giant size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one low sun filtered through moving dust; high contrast rim light and deep shadows.
SURFACE: tangible skin or fur, weathered opaque cloth and stone; dark walnut and antique gold palette with one accent.
SETTING: Karnak in Thebes, plain columns without inscriptions [amun-c08, amun-c29]
MOOD: overwhelming imposing majesty and determined expression, active awe inspiring presence, never ordinary or decorative; respectful living religious deity if applicable.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text anywhere including clothes and stones, NO pseudo glyphs, painted forehead symbols, lettering, signature, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no film/game/anime/comic design; fully opaque clothing covering the whole torso whenever clothed, no nudity, no explicit gore, no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons or runes. Entire head and attributes remain in frame. Cloth ornaments only plain weaving or geometric patterns, no writing.
